acceptance: Each listed adapter fetches Arrow by default, with a config switch back to rows.
BigQuery uses the Storage read API when the extra is installed.
Snowflake outcome recorded: works under pandas 3, or excluded with reason.
A large-result query shows lower measured time on DuckDB.
description: Replace fetchall/list() with Arrow paths in the current drivers (versions from uv.lock): DuckDB 1.5.5 duckdb.py:1049 and MotherDuck motherduck.py:222 — use to_arrow_table/to_arrow_reader (fetch_arrow_table is deprecated); Databricks databricks/adapter.py:2486 (fetchall_arrow); GizmoSQL gizmosql.py:1101 goes through base/sql_execution.py:84 fetchall — use fetch_arrow_table (wrapper at gizmosql.py:310 is only used for schema); Athena athena.py:961 (pyathena 3.36 ArrowCursor / as_arrow); ClickHouse Cloud clickhouse/client.py:257-269 (clickhouse-connect 1.8 query_arrow); chDB clickhouse/client.py:85-107 (keep pa.Table, skip to_pandas); InfluxDB influxdb/client.py:186-196 FlightSQL path only (per-cell as_py; the influxdb3 path at :166-177 is column-wise already). BigQuery bigquery.py:1561: to_arrow works but needs google-cloud-bigquery-storage (not locked) to beat REST; add the bqstorage extra. Snowflake snowflake.py:1323,1334: fetch_arrow_all is gated on the connector's pandas extra, which pins pandas<3 while the project needs pandas>=3 — verify it works or drop Snowflake from this item. Also cover CursorValidationQueryExecutionMixin (core/benchmark_mixins.py:182-189), which calls fetchall inside the timer for Presto/Trino, Redshift and Firebolt; those drivers have no Arrow path, so at minimum avoid double materialization.
